messages.content: Hello! I'm Carolina, and I'm here to have a conversation with you. Let's get started! Given the choice of anyone in the world, whom would you want as a dinner guest?
That sounds lovely! Sharing a meal with a close friend can lead to some wonderful conversations and memories. Would you like to be famous? In what way?
i want to be a celebrity

Being a celebrity can certainly come with a lot of excitement and opportunities! What aspect of celebrity life appeals to you the most? If you could choose, if you were able to live to the age of 90 and retain either the mind or body of a 30-year-old for the last 60 years of your life, which would you want?
